name: markitdown-first
description: Converts PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPUB, HTML, Outlook and more to Markdown with Microsoft markitdown before Claude reads them, so files cost fewer tokens. Pick which file types to convert.

enable_ocr.title: Enable OCR
enable_ocr.description: Read text from scanned PDFs and images inside PDF/Word/PowerPoint/Excel files and image files, using an OpenAI-compatible vision model (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Azure, local Ollama…). Page images are sent to that model's provider. Leave off to convert locally only.

ocr_api_key.title: OCR API key
ocr_api_key.description: API key for the vision model provider. Leave empty for a local endpoint such as Ollama, or to use the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.

ocr_model.title: OCR model
ocr_model.description: Vision model name, e.g. gpt-4o-mini (OpenAI), google/gemini-2.0-flash-001 (OpenRouter), llama3.2-vision (Ollama).

ocr_base_url.title: OCR endpoint URL
ocr_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Empty = OpenAI. Examples: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1
